scientific_integrity: Exact chamber reduction, Dirichlet variance limit shape, finite covariance formula, closed isotropic asymptotic profile and strict derivative certificate; reproducibility tests corroborate but do not replace proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed positive ratio before the dimension tends to infinity; no uniform varying-ratio or finite-dimensional monotonicity theorem. Historical priority and independent proof assessment remain provisional. The shape law concerns uniformly random points, not Hausdorff convergence of whole sets.
title: Strict high-dimensional isotropic profile of ratio-constrained simplex cores
